implemented_capabilities: Read-only source/configuration file discovery with size and directory exclusions
Secrets pattern scanner with redacted evidence
Remediation advisor that does not edit files
Severity summary and heuristic risk score
JSON and Markdown reports plus JSONL audit log
Command-line entry point and intentionally insecure synthetic fixtures
limitations: Static pattern matching can produce false positives and miss issues outside implemented rules.
No files are executed or modified by the scanner.
Dependency checks do not use a vulnerability advisory database and do not report CVEs.
Risk score is a triage heuristic and is not a compliance or security certification.
Final runtime verification is pending a Google Colab test run.
